mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room (trade_id, buyer_id, seller_id) VALUES (#{trade_id}, #{buyer_id}, #{seller_id})
INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_id, message_text) VALUES (#{room_id}, #{sender_id}, #{message_text})
mapper.select: SELECT cm.*, m.nickname AS sender_nickname, m.profile_img AS sender_profile FROM chat_message cm JOIN member m ON cm.sender_id = m.member_id WHERE cm.room_id = #{room_id} ORDER BY cm.sent_at ASC

SELECT cr.*, sb.title AS trade_title, sb.thumb_img AS trade_thumb_img, sb.price_point AS trade_price, sb.status AS trade_status, buyer.nickname AS buyer_nickname, seller.nickname AS seller_nickname, (SELECT message_text FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message, (SELECT sent_at FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_message_time, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = cr.room_id AND sender_id != #{member_id} AND is_read = 'N') AS unread_count FROM chat_room cr JOIN saletrade_board sb ON cr.trade_id = sb.trade_id JOIN member buyer ON cr.buyer_id = buyer.member_id JOIN member seller ON cr.seller_id = seller.member_id WHERE cr.buyer_id = #{member_id} OR cr.seller_id = #{member_id} ORDER BY last_message_time DESC
